title: pereskiopsis spathulata
intro: Pereskiopsis spathulata, commonly known as the "Night-blooming Cereus" or "Queen of the Night", is a cactus species native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the treatment of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Pereskiopsis spathulata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which have been identified in studies on the plant's extracts.
